description: This file defines the PipelineElementVisitor interface and its nested Builder interface, which provides a way to evaluate and handle different pipeline element states within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PipelineElementVisitor
classes.description: Interface for evaluating pipeline elements with methods for handling resolved values, unresolved state, and deletion.

classes.name: PipelineElementVisitor.Builder
classes.description: Nested interface for building a PipelineElementVisitor with configurable callbacks.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Defines how to handle a resolved pipeline value.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Defines how to handle an unresolved pipeline element.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Defines how to handle a deletion signal for the pipeline.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an instance of PipelineElementVisitor based on configured callbacks.
